title: Executable JARs

richText: What an executable JAR contains
A JAR is a Java archive. It packages compiled classes and related files.
A Spring Boot executable JAR also contains runtime dependencies and a launcher.
A servlet web application usually includes an embedded server such as Tomcat. It does not need a separately installed servlet container.
The machine still needs a compatible Java runtime. The JAR does not include Java itself.
Database servers, credentials and other external services are not supplied by the JAR.
Build and run the application
The Spring Boot Maven plugin repackages the application into an executable archive.
The Spring Boot Gradle plugin supplies the bootJar task.
Use the project’s wrapper and declared Java version. Keep plugin versions aligned with the application’s Spring Boot version.

richText: Choose where the application runs
Managed hosting runs the application process and handles parts of the hosting environment.
A virtual private server (VPS) gives you a machine to maintain yourself.
Keep environment-specific configuration and credentials outside the artifact.
A successful build only proves packaging succeeded. Check startup and the deployed application’s behavior separately.
